title.value: Decision Models and Technology Can Help Psychiatry Develop Biomarkers
title.justification: The title is explicitly mentioned in the citation of the paper provided in the text.
title.quote:
Citation:
Barron DS, Baker JT, Budde KS, Bzdok D, Eickhoff SB, Friston KJ, Fox PT, Geha P, Heisig S, Holmes A, Onnela J-P, Powers A, Silbersweig D and Krystal JH (2021) Decision Models and Technology Can Help Psychiatry Develop Biomarkers. Front. Psychiatry 12:706655. doi: 10.3389/fpsyt.2021.706655

analysis.description: The paper discusses the challenges in developing clinically useful biomarkers in psychiatry and proposes a framework that integrates quantitative clinical data and decision models using digital and data technologies. It suggests that operationalizing decision models could help in the development of psychiatric biomarkers.

type.justification: The paper primarily discusses theoretical concepts on how decision models can contribute to identifying biomarkers in psychiatry using examples from other medical fields. It does not present new empirical findings but rather a conceptual analysis.
type.quote: Though many medical specialties rely on quantitative clinical data and operationalized decision models... Here, psychiatry might benefit from digital technologies that have recently emerged specifically to quantify clinically relevant facets of human behavior.

name.justification: The main discussion revolves around challenges and frameworks in identifying biomarkers specific to psychiatry.
name.quote: Why is psychiatry unable to define clinically useful biomarkers? We explore this question from the vantage of data and decision science...

name.justification: The paper proposes the use of digital phenotyping to quantify clinical data and operationalize decision models in psychiatry.
name.quote: Psychiatry is in a conundrum... Here, psychiatry might benefit from digital technologies that have recently emerged specifically to quantify human behavior.

name.justification: Machine learning is discussed as a method for developing and evaluating biomarkers in psychiatry.
name.quote: Predictive biomarker studies use specialized methods to identify values... For example, machine-learning models trained on a large group can be validated and applied to individuals.
